state:
Goal `tools-php-differences`: 5 of the chapter's 12 features are done: `arrays-and-strings`, `classes`, `closures-and-callables`, `the-short-list` and `files-tags-and-names`. `bun nv proofs --owed --group tools:php-differences` lists the 7 still owed.
So far the proofs have corrected seven rows of `docs/reference/tools/30-php-differences.md`. This session fixed two of them: § *The short list* named "around 450" `Core` members when the registry has 873, and the row now gives no count. § *Files, tags and names* gave `E0306` for `use function`, and the first code is `E0252`.
A second `namespace X;` in one file, or one after a root-namespace class, compiles without an error, although the row and `E0243`'s doc refuse it. Gap `nvs-syntax/a-second-namespace-statement-in-one-file-compiles` records it and names what the fix breaks.
Each feature here owes one example, one attack and one case carrying `// covers:`. It owes no `about.md` or bench. `the-tools-you-do-not-install` also owes help: its section shows no code block.
Gap `nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops` still marks the arrays-and-strings attack.
